description: This is a Java test class for the RxSharedPrefs component in the com.anysoftkeyboard.prefs package. It contains unit tests for preferences restoration, updates, conversions, and behavior under different user unlock states, utilizing Robolectric and JUnit frameworks.

classes.name: RxSharedPrefsTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the RxSharedPrefs class, focusing on preferences restoration, updates, conversions, and behavior under different user states.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the CompositeDisposable before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Disposes of the CompositeDisposable after each test.

methods.name: testRestoreFunction
methods.description: Callback to verify the restore operation with a given input file.

methods.name: testLevelSet
methods.description: Verifies that the configuration level preference is correctly set after initializing RxSharedPrefs.

methods.name: testBooleanHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the preference retrieval and observable update for a boolean preference.

methods.name: testStringHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the preference retrieval and observable update for a string preference.

methods.name: testDoesNotUpdateVibrationIfNewInstall
methods.description: Checks that vibration preferences are not set on a fresh install.

methods.name: testDoesNotUpdateVibrationIfNotSetBefore
methods.description: Verifies that vibration preferences are not updated if not previously set.

methods.name: testUpdatesVibrationIfSetBefore
methods.description: Tests that vibration preferences are correctly migrated if previously set.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashIfPreviousValueWasNotInteger
methods.description: Ensures no crash occurs if a previous vibration preference was a non-integer value.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashIfPreviousValueWasNull
methods.description: Ensures no crash occurs if a previous vibration preference was null.

methods.name: testDoesNotUpdateZoomFactorIfNotPresent
methods.description: Checks that zoom preferences are not set if not previously present.

methods.name: testUpdatesZoomFactorIfPresent
methods.description: Verifies that zoom preferences are migrated correctly if previously set.

methods.name: testSetupFallbackDictionaryToFalseIfWasNotSetBefore
methods.description: Tests fallback dictionary preference setup for default false if not previously set.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetupFallbackDictionaryIfConfigurationVersionIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures fallback dictionary preference is not set if configuration version is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetupFallbackDictionaryIfConfigurationVersion12
methods.description: Ensures fallback dictionary preference is not set if configuration version is 12.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetupFallbackDictionaryToFalseIfWasSetBeforeToFalse
methods.description: Verifies fallback dictionary preference remains unchanged if previously set to false.

methods.name: testDoesNotSetupFallbackDictionaryToFalseIfWasSetBeforeToTrue
methods.description: Verifies fallback dictionary preference remains unchanged if previously set to true.

methods.name: testConvertTheme
methods.description: Tests conversion of theme preferences based on configuration version.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertThemeIfNoPrefEntry
methods.description: Ensures theme conversion does not occur if preference entry is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertThemeIfConfigLevelIsHigh
methods.description: Verifies theme conversion is skipped if configuration level is high.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertThemeIfFreshInstall
methods.description: Ensures theme conversion does not occur on a fresh install.

methods.name: testConvertQuickKey
methods.description: Tests conversion of quick key preferences based on configuration version.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertQuickKeyIfNoPrefEntry
methods.description: Verifies quick key conversion is skipped if preference entry is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertQuickKeyIfConfigLevelIsHigh
methods.description: Ensures quick key conversion is skipped if configuration level is high.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertQuickKeyIfFreshInstall
methods.description: Verifies quick key conversion does not occur on a fresh install.

methods.name: testConvertTopGenericRow
methods.description: Tests conversion of top row preferences based on configuration version.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertTopGenericRowIfNoPrefEntry
methods.description: Ensures top row conversion is skipped if preference entry is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertTopGenericRowIfConfigLevelIsHigh
methods.description: Verifies top row conversion is skipped if configuration level is high.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertTopGenericRowIfFreshInstall
methods.description: Ensures top row conversion does not occur on a fresh install.

methods.name: testConvertBottomGenericRow
methods.description: Tests conversion of bottom row preferences based on configuration version.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertBottomGenericRowIfNoPrefEntry
methods.description: Ensures bottom row conversion is skipped if preference entry is missing.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertBottomGenericRowIfConfigLevelIsHigh
methods.description: Verifies bottom row conversion is skipped if configuration level is high.

methods.name: testDoesNotConvertBottomGenericRowIfFreshInstall
methods.description: Ensures bottom row conversion does not occur on a fresh install.

methods.name: testDoesNotAutoApplyPrefFileIfNoPermission
methods.description: Tests that auto-apply of preferences file is skipped if no storage permission.

methods.name: testDoesNotAutoApplyPrefFileIfNoApplyFile
methods.description: Ensures auto-apply is skipped if no preferences file exists.

methods.name: testDoesNotCrashOnException
methods.description: Verifies that exceptions during auto-apply do not crash the app.

methods.name: testHappyPathAppliesIfWritePermissionAndHasFile
methods.description: Tests successful auto-apply when permissions are granted and file exists.

methods.name: testUpdatesStatisticsAndApplyFileOnlyWhenUserUnlocks
methods.description: Checks that preferences are only applied after user unlocks.

methods.name: testUpdatesStatisticsAndApplyFileIfUserAlreadyUnlocked
methods.description: Verifies preferences are applied immediately if user is already unlocked.

methods.name: testReturnsDefaultsUntilUserUnlocks
methods.description: Tests that default preferences are returned until user unlocks, then actual values are loaded.
